It has over 300 million active customer accounts globally.[[37]](#cite_note-38)

Amazon saw large growth during the [COVID-19 pandemic](/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic "COVID-19 pandemic"), hiring more than 100,000 staff in the [United States](/wiki/United_States "United States") and [Canada](/wiki/Canada "Canada").[[38]](#cite_note-39) Some Amazon workers in the US, France, and Italy protested the company's decision to "run normal shifts" due to COVID-19's ease of spread in warehouses.[[39]](#cite_note-auto-40)[[40]](#cite_note-FTMarch19-41) In Spain, the company faced legal complaints over its policies,[[41]](#cite_note-BBCMarch31-42) while a group of US Senators wrote an open letter to Bezos expressing concerns about workplace safety.[[42]](#cite_note-TheVergeMarch31-43)

The largest city, [Philadelphia](/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia"), has a [humid subtropical climate](/wiki/Humid_subtropical_climate "Humid subtropical climate") (Köppen *Cfa*).

Summers are generally hot and humid. Moving toward the mountainous interior of the state, the winter climate becomes colder, the number of cloudy days increases, and snowfall amounts are greater. Olympia has a warm-summer [Mediterranean climate](/wiki/Mediterranean_climate "Mediterranean climate") ([Köppen](/wiki/K%C3%B6ppen_climate_classification "Köppen climate classification"): *Csb*). The local [microclimate](/wiki/Microclimate "Microclimate") has dry summers in July and mildly humid summers in early June and late August, with cool July and August overnight lows. It is part of USDA [Hardiness zone](/wiki/Hardiness_zone "Hardiness zone") 8a, with isolated pockets around Puget Sound in zone 8b.[[19]](#cite_note-19) Most of western Washington's weather is brought in by weather systems that form near the [Aleutian Islands](/wiki/Aleutian_Islands "Aleutian Islands") in [Alaska](/wiki/Alaska "Alaska"). It contains cold moist air, which brings western Washington cold rain, cloudiness, and fog. November through January are Olympia's rainiest months. City streets, creeks, and rivers can flood from November to February. The monthly mean temperature ranges from 38.4 °F (3.6 °C) in December to 64.1 °F (17.8 °C) in August.
